newsitem.title: FINLAND: VIHERJUURI SEES HIGHER '97 SALES MARGIN.
newsitem.headline: VIHERJUURI SEES HIGHER '97 SALES MARGIN.

text.p: Finnish advertising group Markkinointi Viherjuuri Oy said on Monday it expected its sales margin to rise in 1997 on 1996 and that it targetted a higher dividend payout.
"Sales margin growth is expected to continue steadily," Viherjuuri said in its 1996 financial statement. Its 1996 sales margin rose to 74.2 million markka from 63.7 million markka.
"A key target is to lift group profitability to a level where the dividend payout capacity would be better," it said.
Viherjuuri proposed a 1.20 markka dividend for 1996, up from 1.00 markka in 1995.
